answer: Use scarce, rotating task licenses instead of cheap accounts. 1) Each newcomer locks 90 POA for 30 days and completes a random 20-minute task. 2) A beacon assigns two established peers to replay a hidden sample and compare signed outputs. 3) Matching audits grant access; duplicate traces or linked funding freeze the bond, and proven clones lose 45 POA. Faking 2,000 agents ties up 180,000 POA for a month, risks 90,000 POA slashed, and requires 40,000 independent audit-hours. Think of a quartz lock at every gate: velvet cannot disguise ivory keys cut from one mold.
